tools.name: search_creators
tools.description: Find creators with a live Piku page by niche words (matched against the niches they chose, then their bio and Rates), location (their city and country, then their bio), platform and starting price. Prices are starting prices in the creator's currency; max_from_price is compared after converting curr

tools.name: get_rate_card
tools.description: A creator's Rate Card and media kit: every Rate with its stable id, price as the creator shows it (visibility full, from_price or request_only), what it includes, and the self-reported audience.

tools.name: submit_request
tools.description: Send a brand's request on one Rate of a creator. Piku emails the brand a confirm link; the request reaches the creator's Deals only after the brand confirms, within 48 hours. Needs the creator's handle, the Rate id, the brand's name and contact email, and a short brief, as the user gave them. Return

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Where a request stands: awaiting_confirmation, expired, requested, quoted, accepted or declined. Pass the request_id from submit_request as deal_id. When quoted, the quote total, currency and the brand's approval link are included.

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). The connected creator's Deals, newest first, and their unsent Drafts. Each has its client, title, stage, amount and id. Filter by client name or stage.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). Prepare a quote to one of the creator's clients as a Draft: Lines, up to three billing options (one_off, monthly, quarterly, annual), payment terms and split. client.email is where the link goes: without it (and send_by email or both)

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). Prepare an invoice to one of the creator's clients as a Draft, paid in full or split. client.email is where the link goes: without it (and send_by email or both) the tool answers needs_client_email. send_by self emails nothing. Nothing

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). The connected creator's invoices, newest first: number, client, amount, status (due, overdue, paid, void) and due date. Invoices the creator archived are left out; get_invoice still reads one by its number.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). One invoice by its number, like INV-0042: its Lines, amount, status, due date, period, receipt and pay link.

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). Send one Draft to its client: a quote goes out with its accept link; an invoice is numbered and goes out with its pay link (or, with send_by self, is marked sent for the creator to send). For use only after the creator has seen this Dr

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). The connected creator's public page as data: name, bio, the button look (colour, shape, alignment), the sections (tabs) in order, links and widgets with their ids, Rates in order, the choices the page builder offers, and any open Page

tools.name: design_page
tools.description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). Propose a design for the creator's page as a Page draft: any of the button look, bio, link titles, the order of links, widgets, sections and Rates, and new links or widgets from addresses the creator gave you. Every field is optional;

tools.name: list_page_drafts
tools.description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). The connected creator's recent Page drafts: status (draft, applied, discarded, replaced, expired), the parts applied, and the preview link.
